nodes.label: 4-step onboarding flow (Domain to Assessment to ELO Result to Plan)
nodes.rationale: strongest UX moment on the platform - clear, visually polished, delivers a personalized skill snapshot within 5 minutes

nodes.label: UX-P0-1: free-text keyword field
nodes.rationale: whatever is typed drives all 25 MCQ questions, Aura page title, and skill radar labels for every future session; recommended fix is a searchable role picker seeded from roleConfig.js's 44 roles

nodes.label: UX-P0-2: cold-start Render.com error exposed to students
nodes.rationale: 'Production server is cold-starting (Render.com)' exposes backend infrastructure language on a student's very first action

nodes.label: UX-P0-3: cold dashboard with zero guidance
nodes.rationale: post-onboarding Aura page shows all-zero stat cards with no first-action prompt or tutorial layer

nodes.label: UX-P0-4: Launchpad empty on Day 1
nodes.rationale: destroys the core MBA/Pharmacy value proposition on first contact, causing immediate churn for job-placement-focused personas

nodes.label: UX-P0-5: placement officer all-zero dashboard
nodes.rationale: four zeros on first screen with no getting-started checklist; a placement officer who sees this will not trust the platform to be ready for 2000 students

nodes.label: UX-P0-6: RecoPopup navigation race condition
nodes.rationale: Study in Skill Studio links go to /skill-studio while savingResult is still true; navigating before save completes renders Skill Studio with an incomplete profile

nodes.label: UX-P1-1: ELO number shown with no re-explanation
nodes.rationale: ELO is explained once at the assessment result screen only; on Aura and the header badge it appears with no tooltip or tier context
